items.title: Why we stopped hand-building TYPO3 templates
items.description: Every project used to start with three weeks of template work. Now it starts with composer require. Here are the numbers that convinced us, and what we do with the time instead.

items.title: How 62 components keep 244 elements consistent
items.description: Desiderio has 17 atoms, 37 molecules, 4 layouts and 4 organisms. Together they keep every element consistent, including the ones you build yourself.

items.title: Accessibility foundations, checked on every commit
items.description: Semantic markup, visible focus styles, contrast tests for all 15 presets and automated template checks give your accessibility review a better start. Conformance still depends on your content, integrations and tests with real users.
